newsitem.title: UK: UK estate agents fear housing setback from budget.
newsitem.headline: UK estate agents fear housing setback from budget.

text.p: Estate agents believe the recovery in Britain's housing market is vulnerable to a setback from any negative measures in the annual budget in November, a building society survey said on Tuesday.

"UK estate agents now feel the recovery (in the housing market) is fragile, and that negative moves in the budget could cause a slow down or even a reversal," the survey by Birmingham Midshires Building Society said.

"Estates agents' biggest fear is a further reduction in mortgage interest (tax) relief," it said. A further rise in interest rates would also damage the market, it said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
